## Problem to Solve

Describe the general-purpose problem, usage scenario, and affected users. Do not start with only a proposed class or method.

## Why It Belongs Here

Explain why the capability has cross-project value and should live in a shared library rather than an application project.

## Proposed Solution

Describe the expected behavior, public API, configuration, and failure semantics. Include a code sketch when useful.

## Alternatives

List existing tools, application-level implementations, or other approaches you considered and explain their limitations.

## Compatibility and Cost

- Compatible with PHP `>=5.6`:
- Requires new dependencies:
- Changes an existing public API:
- Requires migration or a new major version:
- Expected testing and maintenance cost:

## Additional Context

Include relevant standards, documentation, examples, or comparisons.
